_comment: Product identifiers only. PRICES ARE NEVER STORED HERE or anywhere else in this repository - they are read from the App Store at runtime, localised, which is the only place that stays correct when a price changes. These identifiers must match the ones configured in App Store Connect.
_subscriptions: Two independent auto-renewing subscriptions in SEPARATE subscription groups, so a pilot can hold either, both, or neither, and buying one never cancels or upgrades the other. 'pro' unlocks the airplanes, the syllabus and the recorder; 'multiplayer' is the pass that lets you fly online and is needed by everyone who goes online, including members who get 'pro' through an external provider.
